We've gotten to the point where many companies are building faster than they can learn. Velocity is *not* the problem.

Kicker is... if you do this long enough eventually the complexity catches up to you. And velocity/ability to "deliver" IS the problem.

#prodmgmt #ux #design

The shift from “delivery” teams (a cost) to problem solving, innovating, upside exploring teams (revenue) is a fascinating one.

One is “in service” to the business. Order takers.

The other *is* the business...and in service to customers. Order creators :)
